title: 多运行时环境隔离与显式生命周期所有权
summary: 多个原生/AI 引擎不共享隐式 shell 环境；每个运行时使用自己的绝对可执行路径、工作目录与受控环境，并通过 registry/supervisor 管理生命周期与互斥资源。
principles: Do not depend on the caller shell's implicit PATH or active virtual environment.
Each engine/runtime SHOULD own its dependency environment.
Adapters/sidecars SHOULD separate protocol integration from dependency environments.
Supervisor ownership MUST be explicit before terminating or replacing a conflicting process.
Machine-local runtime paths SHOULD stay out of version-controlled semantic registries when possible.
